{{Quote|Ben, come to the galley this instant!''"<br />"''Uh, that might not be such a good idea. At least not until he's had a good saniscrubbing.|Mara Jade Skywalker and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
A '''saniscrub''' was a cleaning process used to remove substances from an individual's body.<ref name="JK" /> In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] said that his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], needed a saniscrubbing after becoming covered in [[Servomotor/Legends|servomotor]] [[Lubricant/Legends|lubricant]] while working on the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'s'' utility deck.<ref name="JK" />
